newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DI CANIO LEAVES CELTIC IN BLINKER SWAP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DI CANIO LEAVES CELTIC IN BLINKER SWAP.

text.p: Unsettled Italian striker Paolo di Canio has signed for Sheffield Wednesday from Celtic in return for Dutch international Regi Blinker and a three million pound ($4.9 million) fee.
Wednesday said the transfer was a record for the English premier league club while Celtic blasted the former Juventus and Milan winger for his behaviour in Scotland.
Celtic had been chasing Blinker for some time and had originally intended to pair him with Di Canio.
Di Canio had been discontented with Celtic for some time despite being a crowd favourite with 12 league goals last season before his relationship with the club soured.
Celtic said that the signing of Blinker had been made dependant on the English club being allowed to approach Di Canio in return about a possible move.
"The breakthrough in the deal was Paolo di Canio," said Celtic general manager Jock Brown at a news conference in Glasgow before a similar one in Sheffield.

"We have not initiated a sale, which is what many clubs have wanted. (Coach) Wim (Jansen) wanted Blinker. (Wednesday manager) David Pleat would not let him go unless we agreed to let him speak to Di Canio.
"Di Canio has not acted in the behaviour fitting of a Celtic player and has, in fact, let down the club, the supporters and himself.
"These factors, added to the feeling of many of the supporters, make it sensible for Celtic to do a deal."
Blinker said he was delighted to work with Jansen again, the coach who gave him his professional start at Feyenoord.
Di Canio links up with fellow Italian and former Internazionale Milan midfielder Benito Carbone at Wednesday.
